01 / THE INTRODUCTIONA little context, beyond the projects.
HELLO, I’M PUSHPIKA

Curiosity at the core.
Code as the craft.

I’m a software engineer with a background in Computer Engineering at the University of Peradeniya. This is my space to share the things I build, the ideas I explore, and the work that comes next.

I’m interested in the point where thoughtful engineering meets a useful, intuitive experience. For me, building software starts with understanding the problem, asking good questions, and finding a clear way forward.

01 / DESIGN

Interfaces that feel intuitive.

I design web and mobile experiences that help people find their way, understand their options, and take the next step. I focus on clear layouts, thoughtful interaction, and a visual language that gives every screen a sense of purpose.

The whole product, connected.

I build across the stack, bringing interfaces, application logic, and data together. From web applications and SaaS products to custom tools, my work connects the visible experience with the systems behind it: APIs, sign-in flows, dashboards, databases, and content integrations.
